author: Phuc Luu
name: Clean Architecture Template Solution
description: Clean Architecture solution (.NET 10, EF Core + PostgreSQL, MediatR, FluentValidation, Mapster). NuGet packages are updated to the latest stable versions when the solution is created.

UpdatePackages.description: Run 'dotnet package update' after creating the solution so every NuGet package is at the latest stable version. Set to false to keep the versions pinned in the template (e.g. when offline).

postActions.description: Update all NuGet packages to the latest stable versions

manualInstructions.text: Run 'dotnet package update' in the solution folder

args.args: /c "dotnet package update & if errorlevel 2 (exit /b 0) else if errorlevel 1 (exit /b 1) else (exit /b 0)"

postActions.description: Update all NuGet packages to the latest stable versions

manualInstructions.text: Run 'dotnet package update' in the solution folder

args.args: -c "dotnet package update; c=$?; if [ $c -eq 2 ]; then exit 0; fi; exit $c"
